Fix outliers in the model

Source: R/fixOutlier.R
fixOutlier.Rd

Fixes detected outliers to prevent re-detection

Usage

fixOutlier(x, timespan = 12, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

x

a persephone object

timespan

number of months from the end of the time series where outliers are not fixed

verbose

if TRUE the changed parameters will be reported
